name: set_flow_status
title: Switch a flow on or off
description:
Switch a flow on (`active`) or off (`inactive`), with the `confirmation` code from
`preview_flow_status`. On, it answers real customers. Off, it stops answering them, and
conversations already in it finish. A flow that is not live switches off without a code.  The answer's
`still_answered_elsewhere` names any way in another live flow still answers.
